summary.text: Maureen Gault is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 24, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Carter Barrett.
An accountant who lives in Forsyth County, she says she is running on healthcare costs, veterans' healthcare and medical debt.

paragraphs.text: Gault earned a high school diploma from Tift County High School and a graduate degree from Valdosta State University in 2013, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working in accounting.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in Tifton, has lived in Forsyth County for six years, and earned a business administration degree in 2012 and a Master of Accountancy in 2013, both from Valdosta State University.

Gault said in the survey that rising healthcare costs have caused insurance premiums to climb, that veterans' healthcare is understaffed and underfunded, and that medical debt should not be a leading contributor to household bankruptcy.
She also said she is running because she believes Georgia deserves to be represented by people who understand their constituents' lives.
